instruction: Convert this document to an audio file using LibreOffice's text-to-speech feature, then enable voice-to-text editing mode so I can edit the document by speaking.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in text-to-speech document conversion or voice-to-text editing capabilities. While some operating systems have accessibility features for text-to-speech, LibreOffice itself does not provide native audio export or voice editing modes.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies task as infeasible since LibreOffice Writer lacks the requested text-to-speech document conversion and voice-to-text editing features
The 'infeasible' function is the appropriate evaluator response for tasks requesting non-existent functionality
Complete coverage: properly handles entire instruction by marking as infeasible rather than attempting partial verification of impossible requirements
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task cannot be completed
